1.english_reference: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן יוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: Ἐν ἔτει δευτέρῳ τῷ Ἰωὰς υἱῷ Ἰωαχὰς βασιλεῖ Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: In anno secúndo Ioas fílii Ióachaz regis Israel ,
traditions.KJV: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel

1.english_reference: reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah .

traditions.WLC: מָלַ֛ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ בֶן יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ἀμεσσείας υἱὸς Ἰωὰς βασιλεὺς Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: regnávit Amasías fílius Ioas regis Iuda .
traditions.KJV: reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah .

2.english_reference: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְ מָלְכ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: υἱὸς εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν ἦν ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Vigínti quinque annórum erat cum regnáre cœpísset :
traditions.KJV: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign ,

2.english_reference: and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: וְ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָ תֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴκοσι καὶ ἐννέα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: vigínti autem et novem annis regnávit in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ יהועדין מִן יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἰωαδεὶμ ἐξ Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: nomen matris eius Ióadan de Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .

3.english_reference: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֤עַשׂ הַ יָּשָׁר֙ בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ὀφθαλμοῖς Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Et fecit rectum coram Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD ,

3.english_reference: yet not like David his father :

traditions.WLC: רַ֕ק לֹ֖א כְּ דָוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י
traditions.LXX: πλὴν οὐχ ὡς Δαυεὶδ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: verúmtamen non ut David pater eius .
traditions.KJV: yet not like David his father :

3.english_reference: he did according to all things as Joash his father did .

traditions.WLC: ו כְּ כֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֛ה יוֹאָ֥שׁ אָבִ֖י ו עָשָֽׂה
traditions.LXX: κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν Ἰωὰς ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐποίησεν .
traditions.VUL: Iuxta ómnia , quæ fecit Ioas pater suus , fecit :
traditions.KJV: he did according to all things as Joash his father did .

4.english_reference: Howbeit the high places were not taken away :

traditions.WLC: רַ֥ק הַ בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ
traditions.LXX: πλὴν τὰ ὑψηλὰ οὐκ ἐξῆρεν ·
traditions.VUL: nisi hoc tantum , quod excélsa non ábstulit :
traditions.KJV: Howbeit the high places were not taken away :

4.english_reference: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places .

traditions.WLC: ע֥וֹד הָ עָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽ מְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּ בָּמֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: ἔτι ὁ λαὸς ἐθυσίασεν καὶ ἐθυμίων ἐν τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς .
traditions.VUL: adhuc enim pópulus immolábat , et adolébat incénsum in excélsis .
traditions.KJV: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places .

5.english_reference: And it came to pass , as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֕י כַּ אֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַ מַּמְלָכָ֖ה בְּ יָד֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε κατίσχυσεν ἡ βασιλεία ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque obtinuísset regnum ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand ,

5.english_reference: that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּךְ֙ אֶת עֲבָדָ֔י ו הַ מַּכִּ֖ים אֶת הַ מֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ τοὺς πατάξαντας τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: percússit servos suos , qui interfécerant regem patrem suum :
traditions.KJV: that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father .

6.english_reference: But the children of the murderers he slew not :

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י הַ מַּכִּ֖ים לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν παταξάντων οὐκ ἐθανάτωσεν ,
traditions.VUL: fílios autem eórum , qui occíderant , non occídit ,
traditions.KJV: But the children of the murderers he slew not :

6.english_reference: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses ,

traditions.WLC: כַּ כָּת֣וּב בְּ סֵ֣פֶר תּֽוֹרַת מֹ֠שֶׁה
traditions.LXX: καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν βιβλίῳ νόμων Μωυσῆ ,
traditions.VUL: iuxta quod scriptum est in libro legis Móysi ,
traditions.KJV: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵ אמֹ֗ר
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐνετείλατο Κύριος λέγων
traditions.VUL: sicut præcépit Dóminus , dicens :
traditions.KJV: wherein the LORD commanded , saying ,

6.english_reference: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , nor the children be put to death for the fathers ;

traditions.WLC: לֹא יוּמְת֨וּ אָב֤וֹת עַל בָּנִים֙ וּ בָנִים֙ לֹא יוּמְת֣וּ עַל אָב֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: Οὐκ ἀποθανοῦνται πατέρες ὑπὲρ υἱῶν , καὶ υἱοὶ οὐκ ἀποθανοῦνται ὑπὲρ πατέρων ,
traditions.VUL: Non moriéntur patres pro fíliis , neque fílii moriéntur pro pátribus :
traditions.KJV: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , nor the children be put to death for the fathers ;

6.english_reference: but every man shall be put to death for his own sin .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י אִם אִ֥ישׁ בְּ חֶטְא֖ וֹ ימות
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἀλλ᾽ ἢ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτοῦ ἀποθανεῖται .
traditions.VUL: sed unusquísque in peccáto suo moriétur .
traditions.KJV: but every man shall be put to death for his own sin .

7.english_reference: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand ,

traditions.WLC: הוּא הִכָּ֨ה אֶת אֱד֤וֹם בְּ גֵיא המלח עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς ἐπάταξεν τὴν Ἐδὼμ ἐν Ῥεμέλε δέκα χιλιάδας ,
traditions.VUL: Ipse percússit Edom in valle Salinárum decem míllia ,
traditions.KJV: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand ,

traditions.WLC: וְ תָפַ֥שׂ אֶת הַ סֶּ֖לַע בַּ מִּלְחָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνέλαβε τὴν πέτραν ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ ,
traditions.VUL: et apprehéndit petram in prœ́lio ,
traditions.KJV: and took Selah by war ,

7.english_reference: and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֤א אֶת שְׁמָ הּ֙ יָקְתְאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Καθοὴλ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης .
traditions.VUL: vocavítque nomen eius Iéctehel usque in præséntem diem .
traditions.KJV: and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day .

8.english_reference: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash , the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu , king of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: אָ֣ז שָׁלַ֤ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל יְהוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָ֧ז בֶּן יֵה֛וּא מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
traditions.LXX: Τότε ἀπέστειλεν Ἀμεσσείας ἀγγέλους πρὸς Ἰωὰς υἱὸν Ἰωαχὰς υἱοῦ Εἰοὺ βασιλέως Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: Tunc misit Amasías núntios ad Ioas fílium Ióachaz , fílii Iehu regis Israel ,
traditions.KJV: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash , the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu , king of Israel ,

8.english_reference: saying , Come , let us look one another in the face .

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר לְכָ֖ ה נִתְרָאֶ֥ה פָנִֽים
traditions.LXX: λέγων Δεῦρο ὀφθῶμεν προσώποις .
traditions.VUL: dicens : Veni , et videámus nos .
traditions.KJV: saying , Come , let us look one another in the face .

9.english_reference: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֞ח יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֮ לֵ אמֹר֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἰωὰς βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Ἀμεσσείαν βασιλέα Ἰούδα λέγων
traditions.VUL: Remisítque Ioas rex Israel ad Amasíam regem Iuda , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying ,

9.english_reference: The thistle that [ was ] in Lebanon sent to the cedar that [ was ] in Lebanon , saying ,

traditions.WLC: הַ ח֜וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ לְּבָנ֗וֹן שָׁ֠לַח אֶל הָ אֶ֜רֶז אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ לְּבָנוֹן֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: Ὁ ἀκὰν ὁ ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τὴν κέδρον τὴν ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Cárduus Líbani misit ad cedrum , quæ est in Líbano , dicens :
traditions.KJV: The thistle that [ was ] in Lebanon sent to the cedar that [ was ] in Lebanon , saying ,

9.english_reference: Give thy daughter to my son to wife :

traditions.WLC: תְּנָֽ ה אֶת בִּתְּ ךָ֥ לִ בְנִ֖ י לְ אִשָּׁ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Δὸς τὴν θυγατέρα σου τῷ υἱῷ μου εἰς γυναῖκα ·
traditions.VUL: Da fíliam tuam fílio meo uxórem .
traditions.KJV: Give thy daughter to my son to wife :

9.english_reference: and there passed by a wild beast that [ was ] in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .

traditions.WLC: וַֽ תַּעֲבֹ֞ר חַיַּ֤ת הַ שָּׂדֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ לְּבָנ֔וֹן וַ תִּרְמֹ֖ס אֶת הַ חֽוֹחַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ διῆλθον τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ τὰ ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ καὶ συνεπάτησαν τὸν ἀκάνα .
traditions.VUL: Transierúntque béstiæ saltus , quæ sunt in Líbano , et conculcavérunt cárduum .
traditions.KJV: and there passed by a wild beast that [ was ] in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .

10.english_reference: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom , and thine heart hath lifted thee up :

traditions.WLC: הַכֵּ֤ה הִכִּ֨יתָ֙ אֶת אֱד֔וֹם וּֽ נְשָׂאֲ ךָ֖ לִבֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: τύπτων ἐπάταξας τὴν Ἰδουμαίαν , καὶ ἐπῆρέν σε καρδία σου ·
traditions.VUL: Percútiens invaluísti super Edom , et sublevávit te cor tuum :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom , and thine heart hath lifted thee up :

10.english_reference: glory [ of this ] , and tarry at home :

traditions.WLC: הִכָּבֵד֙ וְ שֵׁ֣ב בְּ בֵיתֶ֔ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἐνδοξάσθητι καθήμενος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου .
traditions.VUL: conténtus esto glória , et sede in domo tua :
traditions.KJV: glory [ of this ] , and tarry at home :

10.english_reference: for why shouldest thou meddle to [ thy ] hurt ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לָ֤ מָּה תִתְגָּרֶה֙ בְּ רָעָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἵνα τί ἐρίζεις ἐν κακίᾳ σου ;
traditions.VUL: quare próvocas malum ,
traditions.KJV: for why shouldest thou meddle to [ thy ] hurt ,

10.english_reference: that thou shouldest fall , [ even ] thou , and Judah with thee ?

traditions.WLC: וְ נָ֣פַלְתָּ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה וִ יהוּדָ֥ה עִמָּֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πεσῇ σὺ καὶ Ἰούδας μετὰ σοῦ .
traditions.VUL: ut cadas tu et Iudas tecum ?
traditions.KJV: that thou shouldest fall , [ even ] thou , and Judah with thee ?

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא שָׁמַ֣ע אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσεν Ἀμεσσείας ·
traditions.VUL: Et non acquiévit Amasías .
traditions.KJV: But Amaziah would not hear .

11.english_reference: Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַל יְהוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέβη ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Ascendítque Ioas rex Israel ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up ;

11.english_reference: and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְרָא֣וּ פָנִ֔ים ה֖וּא וַ אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὤφθη προσώποις αὐτὸς καὶ Ἀμεσσείας βασιλεὺς Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: et vidérunt se , ipse et Amasías rex Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face

11.english_reference: at Bethshemesh , which [ belongeth ] to Judah

traditions.WLC: בְּ בֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ יהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐν Βαιθσάμυς γῇ τοῦ Ἰούδα ·
traditions.VUL: in Béthsames óppido Iudæ .
traditions.KJV: at Bethshemesh , which [ belongeth ] to Judah .

12.english_reference: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּנָּ֥גֶף יְהוּדָ֖ה לִ פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔπταισεν Ἰούδας ἀπὸ προσώπου Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Percussúsque est Iuda coram Israel ,
traditions.KJV: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel ;

12.english_reference: and they fled every man to their tents

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּנֻ֖סוּ אִ֥ישׁ ל אהל ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔφυγεν ἀνὴρ εἰς τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et fugérunt unusquísque in tabernácula sua .
traditions.KJV: and they fled every man to their tents .

13.english_reference: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah , at Bethshemesh

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵת֩ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה בֶּן יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ תָּפַ֛שׂ יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ בֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν Ἀμεσσείαν υἱὸν Ἰωὰς υἱοῦ Ἰωαχὰς συνέλαβεν Ἰωὰς βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν Βαιθσάμυς ·
traditions.VUL: Amasíam vero regem Iuda , fílium Ioas fílii Ochozíæ , cepit Ioas rex Israel in Béthsames ,
traditions.KJV: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah , at Bethshemesh ,

traditions.WLC: ו יבאו יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: et addúxit eum in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and came to Jerusalem ,

13.english_reference: and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate , four hundred cubits

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּפְרֹץ֩ בְּ חוֹמַ֨ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם בְּ שַׁ֤עַר אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד שַׁ֣עַר הַ פִּנָּ֔ה אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַמָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ καθεῖλεν ἐν τῷ τείχει Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐν τῇ πύλῃ Ἐφράιμ ἕως πύλης τῆς γωνίας τετρακοσίους πήχεις .
traditions.VUL: et interrúpit murum Ierúsalem , a porta Ephraim usque ad portam ánguli , quadringéntis cúbitis .
traditions.KJV: and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate , four hundred cubits .

traditions.LXX: οὐχὶ ταῦτα γεγραμμένα ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν Ἰσραήλ ;
traditions.VUL: nonne hæc scripta sunt in Libro sermónum diérum regum Israel ?
traditions.KJV: they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

29.english_reference: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers , [ even ] with the kings of Israel

traditions.VUL: Dormivítque Ieróboam cum pátribus suis régibus Israel ,
traditions.KJV: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers , [ even ] with the kings of Israel ;

29.english_reference: and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead
